### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | This is SAGE's publisher-wide AI policy, not a JLD-specific page -- could not confirm a JLD-only variant despite repeated attempts to fetch JLD's own author-instructions/aims-scope pages (they returned only generic site navigation). Assistive AI (grammar/language polishing) is allowed without disclosure. Generative AI producing substantive content (literature-review assistance, translation, AI-generated/enhanced code, data visualization, illustrations, reference compilation) requires disclosure of the tool and its use, typically in Methods or Acknowledgements. AI tools cannot be listed as authors and cannot bear responsibility for content. Prohibited: fabricated content/references, using AI-generated data or AI as a stand-in for real participant interviews, presenting AI images as original research, and undisclosed generative AI use (grounds for rejection at any stage). No prior permission/gate is required before use -- mandatory disclosure at submission is the operative mechanism, hence 'conditional' gate. Leniency rated 3/5: assistive uses are free, generative uses are permitted but gated by mandatory disclosure and several hard prohibitions. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): SAGE's general author guidelines (confirmed on sister SAGE journal Journal of Intellectual Disabilities author-instructions page, not verified journal-specific for JLD itself) state preprints are allowed: authors may post to a preprint server and must supply the DOI; no changes to the preprint while under review; if accepted, must add a link to the final published version in the preprint.
> Source: https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/jld

### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- Unverified WebSearch snippet only (not independently fetched/confirmed): journal covers special series, feature articles, research articles, and intervention articles in the learning disabilities field, multidisciplinary (education, psychology, neurology, medicine, law, counseling) -- treated as low-confidence background, not used to populate accepts_now/methods_welcome
- https://scirev.org/journal/journal-of-learning-disabilities/ -- page explicitly states 'no reviews have yet been submitted for this journal', all metrics n/a
- https://www.ablesci.com/journal/detail?id=rw7a9r -- no review-time/acceptance-rate data present, only bibliometric info (avg. 41 articles/year)
- https://www.sagepub.com/en-us/nam/journal/journal-learning-disabilities (repeated WebFetch attempts returned only site navigation/footer, could not extract journal-specific aims-and-scope prose or recent-article listing)
- https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy
- https://www.sfabiao.com/sci/00222194/ -- no review-time/reviewer-experience data present, only IF/CiteScore/JCR ranking fields, review-time and acceptance-rate explicitly marked unavailable

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type**: Could not fetch a JLD-specific submission-guidelines page with working content extraction (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/ldx and /aims-scope/LDX both returned generic site navigation across repeated attempts, not journal content). A sister SAGE journal (Journal of Intellectual Disabilities) confirmed 'double-anonymized' review, but this cannot be generalized to JLD without journal-specific confirmation, so left null rather than assumed.
- **positioning.accepts_now / methods_welcome / framing_required**: WebFetch on the JLD publisher page returned only site chrome (nav/footer), not aims-and-scope prose or recent article listing; no reliable extraction of current topical scope or methods emphasis was obtained, so left null/empty rather than inferred from unverified generic search snippets.
- **experiential.review_time_months / desk_reject_pct / acceptance_note / reviewer_culture**: SciRev has zero submitted reviews for this journal (explicit 'no reviews have yet been submitted' statement). Chinese aggregator sites (ablesci 科研通, sfabiao 发表吧) show bibliometric data only, with review-time/acceptance fields explicitly marked unavailable. No 小木虫 muchong, 知乎 zhihu, or Reddit r/AskAcademia threads discussing hands-on submission/review experience with this specific journal were found.
- **ai_policy journal-specific variant**: Only SAGE's publisher-wide AI policy page was successfully fetched with content; the JLD-specific author-instructions URL returned generic site content rather than journal text on every attempt, so it is unconfirmed whether JLD adds any journal-specific AI restrictions beyond the publisher default.
